nonNegotiableMobile: Every playable game fully touch-operable: no keyboard-only actions, skills, selection or hidden hotkeys required

Portrait and landscape behavior game-specific; orientation change must resize without losing a scored run or restarting the level
Pause/resume/restart work after tab switch, lock screen, incoming call and app/WebView backgrounding; score clock follows official event rules
Touch pointercancel, multi-touch, swipe, virtual joystick, tap targets and haptics gracefully supported without phantom actions
Respect mobile autoplay policies: sound only after user interaction; muted, suspended and WebView-restricted audio never block gameplay
UI readable at narrow widths and device text scaling, with reduced motion and accessible contrast
Network interruption/offline/PWA and resumption: never fabricate an official scored completion after a connection loss
Mobile resource budgets: adaptive DPR and resolution, asset streaming, bounded CPU/GPU memory and no large allocation churn
Target smooth 60 fps on capable phones; measure P50/P95 frame times and stutter on real hardware; degrade LOD/effects rather than mechanics
Comparable touch control response and server validated score result on both platforms
